note: Track keys (theory-scales-keys), step 6: a chorus moved up a whole step, from C to D, heard, worked out as the same numbers in the new key, then prepared with the new key's 5 chord.

exercise.title: Up a step for the last chorus
exercise.why: Every chord of the chorus moves up by the same whole step, so its numbers stay the same in the new key, and the new key's 5th chord played just before it makes the lift sound prepared.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the backing track: a chorus in C, played twice, then the same chorus a whole step up, in D.
Listen for the bar where everything lifts, and call out "up" there.
When the key goes up, every chord is new but the chorus keeps its shape.

The chorus is 1, 5, 6, 4. Press those four chords in the first row below, the chords of C major, then the same four numbers in the second row, the chords of D major.
Go between the rows until you can say the chorus in D without reading it.

Press Play below to start the backing track. This time the last bar in C is A7, the 5th chord of D, so the new key is announced one bar early.
Look away from the chord boxes and call out "up" on the first bar in D.
Then pick a chorus you know and name the 5th chord that would lift it a whole step.
